entities.title: Login service public keys
entities.summary: The JWKS the app checks sign-in tokens against. Public, the same line every icelander.net app carries.
entities.details: Without it, or without the ACCOUNTS binding, nobody can sign in (fail closed).

entities.title: Stand-in sign-in for tests
entities.summary: DEV_SIGN_IN="true" turns on /apps/z-calendar/auth/dev, only on a localhost address.
entities.details: Must be the string "true"; wrangler's --var passes a boolean, which the library ignores. Needs --local-upstream localhost:<port>.

entities.title: FAF service binding
entities.summary: The service binding to the Worker friends-and-family, entrypoint Internal, which answers dates(viewer, opts) with the family dates that viewer may see.
entities.details: Optional at run time: without it, or when it throws, times out (3 s) or answers nonsense, /api/family-dates says available: false and the client shows a notice. Cloudflare refuses a deploy naming a Worker that does not exist, so friends-and-family deploys first. In the tests, test/faf-mock/ runs in the same wrangler dev under that name.

entities.title: zizd deploy key CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN
entities.summary: The Cloudflare API token the zizd deploy step deploys with: it applies the D1 migrations and deploys the Worker.
entities.type: string (a deploy_keys config key of the zizd pipeline, in the orchestrator; never in this repository)
entities.details: Named by the deploy step of david-brandt-the-icelander/family-calendar:default (.zazzle/zizd/README.md); the step refuses to run without it. No build-phase step gets it.

entities.title: zizd deploy key CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID
entities.summary: The Cloudflare account the zizd deploy step deploys to.
entities.type: string (a deploy_keys config key of the zizd pipeline, in the orchestrator; never in this repository)
entities.details: Named by the deploy step of david-brandt-the-icelander/family-calendar:default (.zazzle/zizd/README.md); the step refuses to run without it. No build-phase step gets it.
